question: At which Olympic Games did the Indian hockey men’s team win its last gold medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian hockey team won a Gold medal **in **1980, Moscow Olympics**.
 
• The Indian hockey team **defeated Spain by 4-3 **and bagged a **gold medal on 29 July 1980**.
 
• It was the **eighth and last Olympic gold medal **won by the Indian Hockey team till now.
 
• **Vasudev Bhaskaran of Tamil Nadu **was the captain of the **1980 hockey team**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian hockey men's team won a **bronze medal in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, after 41 years since 1980**.
 
• Team **India defeated Germany by 5-4**, under the **captaincy of Manpreet Singh**.
 
• The headquarters of the **Indian Hockey Federation is in New Delhi **and its chairperson is **Dilip Tirkey**.
 
• **Major Dhyanchand of India **is known as **Wizard Of Hockey.**
